title: Vegetative Propagation
text: Many valuable plants are propagated from cuttings rather than seeds. The challenge is getting roots to form on the cut stem. This is where auxins help.

title: Rooting Powders
text: Commercial rooting powders contain synthetic auxins like IBA (indole-3-butyric acid). When applied to cuttings, they stimulate the formation of adventitious roots, increasing success rate of propagation.
